description.html: HabiStat Tortoise Food Fruit & Flower in the small pack is a dry pelleted food for tortoises enriched with fruit and flower flavor. This smaller pack is practical for owners who want to try this flavor before buying a larger jar, or for those with one tortoise for whom a smaller amount is just right. The formula contains all-natural ingredients, including dried fruit and flowers that attract tortoises with their aroma and taste.

The nutritional profile is optimized for tortoises - with a high fiber content that supports healthy digestion, a low protein content suited to their natural diet, and added calcium for a strong shell and bones. The food also contains vitamin D3, which helps with proper calcium absorption. The mix of fruit and flowers gives the pellets a pleasant smell and taste, which makes this food very appealing even to the pickiest tortoises.

Before giving them to your tortoises, soak the pellets in warm water for a few minutes so they soften. It is suitable for European tortoises, Russian tortoises and most other tortoise species. HabiStat is a renowned British brand with many years of experience producing reptile food and equipment. If you need a larger amount, see the large Fruit & Flower pack.

All equipment can be ordered by phone or WhatsApp message. Courier delivery across Serbia, in-person pickup in Novi Sad. For questions about the product, compatibility or recommendations for your animal - get in touch.
